articles.title: Optical properties of CdSe nanoparticles
articles.snippet: We report on the optical properties of CdSe nanoparticles (NPs) in water (content change between 5 and 95 % with a step of 5 %). Optical transmission, reflection, refractive index and extinction coefficient were calculated with the transfer-matrix (TM) method. All estimated optical properties were analysed between 300 and 1000 nm in the spectral region. Optical dielectric functions (ε1 and ε2) were obtained from spectral behaviour refractive index and extinction coefficient. The high-frequency dielectric constant, the ratio of the carrier density to the effective mass of the carrier, and relaxation time were obtained from the spectral behaviour of the optical dielectric functions.

articles.title: Ambient surface oxidation of thermally evaporated CdS thin films studied by XPS and EDS
articles.snippet: Cadmium sulphide (CdS) thin films were deposited by thermal vacuum evaporation onto glass substrates and studied with respect to their surface chemical state after exposure to ambient atmosphere. Two series of films with different thicknesses (≈420 nm and ≈560 nm) were prepared under identical deposition conditions. The elemental composition and surface chemistry were investigated using energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). EDS confirms the presence of Cd and S as main constituents, while oxygen and carbon impurities are also detected. XPS survey and high-resolution spectra reveal the formation of surface oxide-related components, attributed to Cd–O and sulphur–oxygen bonds, as well as adventitious carbon species. The results indicate that even without post-deposition thermal treatment, CdS thin films undergo noticeable surface oxidation during storage in air, which may affect the electronic properties of CdS-based heterojunctions, particularly in CdS/CdTe photovoltaic devices.
articles.titleZh: 热蒸发CdS薄膜在环境大气中的表面氧化：XPS和EDS研究
articles.summary: 本文通过热真空蒸发在玻璃基底上沉积CdS薄膜，研究其在环境大气暴露后的表面化学状态。制备了两种不同厚度（约420 nm和560 nm）的薄膜，使用EDS和XPS分析元素组成和表面化学。EDS确认Cd和S为主要成分，同时检测到氧和碳杂质。XPS谱图显示表面氧化物相关组分，归因于Cd-O和硫-氧键以及外来碳物种。结果表明，即使没有沉积后退火，CdS薄膜在空气中储存时也会发生明显的表面氧化，可能影响CdS基异质结（特别是CdS/CdTe光伏器件）的电子性能。证据层级为实验观察，结论限于所研究的薄膜厚度和沉积条件。
keyPoints: 薄膜厚度分别为约420 nm和560 nm
articles.engineeringImpact: 对CdS/CdTe光伏器件制造和储存工艺有启示：需控制环境暴露时间或采用钝化层，以防止表面氧化导致电子性能退化。

paperDetails.objective: 研究热蒸发CdS薄膜在环境大气暴露后的表面化学状态变化
paperDetails.methods: 热真空蒸发沉积，EDS和XPS分析
paperDetails.testObject: 玻璃基底上的CdS薄膜，厚度约420 nm和560 nm
paperDetails.operatingConditions: 环境大气暴露，无后沉积热处理
limitations: 未量化氧化对电子性能的影响

articles.title: Investigation of the radiation-induced process of the titanium silicate surface using Raman spectroscopy
articles.snippet: In this work, the radiation-induced process in titanium silicate (TiSi) was investigated using Raman spectroscopy. The TiSi samples were synthesized by combining sol-gel and hydrothermal methods. The irradiation of titanium silicate was carried out using the ‘Sirius’ facility. The surface was analyzed using EDS and Raman spectrometry. In addition to Raman spectroscopy, the effect of ionising radiation on titanium silicate was assessed by changes in its adsorption capacity toward Zn2+ cations. It was demonstrated that irradiating TiSi in a 0.1 M HNO3 solution has the greatest effect on its properties. The adsorption ability decreases by a factor of three compared with nonirradiated samples. This fact must be taken into account when using titanium silicate for the adsorption of radionuclides from aqueous solutions.
articles.titleZh: 利用拉曼光谱研究钛硅酸盐表面的辐射诱导过程
articles.summary: 本文采用溶胶-凝胶和水热法合成钛硅酸盐（TiSi）样品，利用拉曼光谱和EDS分析其表面，并通过“Sirius”设施进行辐照。研究发现，在0.1 M HNO3溶液中辐照对TiSi性能影响最大，吸附Zn2+阳离子的能力比未辐照样品降低三倍。该结果基于实验测量，表明辐照会显著降低TiSi的吸附能力，需在放射性核素吸附应用中予以考虑。
keyPoints: TiSi样品通过溶胶-凝胶和水热法合成
辐照在0.1 M HNO3溶液中进行
吸附能力降低三倍是基于实验对比
articles.engineeringImpact: 该研究提示在风电设备中若使用钛硅酸盐作为吸附材料（如处理冷却水中的放射性核素），需考虑辐照环境对其吸附性能的衰减影响，可能需增加材料用量或更换周期。

articles.title: Quantum chemical study of the electrostatic potential in the vicinity of active centers on the anatase surface and its derivative doped with an Ag2 cluster
articles.snippet: Quantum chemical modeling of Ag dimer adsorption centers on the (001) anatase surface was performed using the density functional method with the hybrid exchange-correlation functional B3LYP and the LANL2DZ basis set. Molecular electrostatic potential distribution maps were constructed in the vicinity of active centers on the surface of pure and silver-doped anatase. It has been shown that the nature of its distribution for the adsorption complex of Ag2 dimer on the surface of the Ti15O41H22 cluster contributes to the formation of OH• radicals responsible for antimicrobial activity.
articles.titleZh: 锐钛矿表面活性中心附近静电势的量子化学研究及其Ag2团簇掺杂衍生物
articles.summary: 采用密度泛函方法（B3LYP/LANL2DZ）对Ag二聚体在锐钛矿(001)表面的吸附中心进行量子化学建模，构建了纯锐钛矿和银掺杂锐钛矿表面活性中心附近的分子静电势分布图。结果表明，Ag2二聚体在Ti15O41H22团簇表面的吸附复合物静电势分布有助于形成具有抗菌活性的OH•自由基。该研究为理论计算，未涉及实验验证。
keyPoints: 使用B3LYP/LANL2DZ方法进行量子化学建模
articles.engineeringImpact: 该理论模型可为风电设备中抗菌涂层材料的设计提供参考，通过掺杂Ag团簇调控表面静电势以增强抗菌性能，但需实验验证。

paperDetails.objective: 研究Ag2团簇掺杂锐钛矿表面的静电势分布及其对抗菌活性的影响
limitations: 纯理论计算，无实验数据
